en: Sepia-toned panoramic view of an early 20th‑century European city with dense blocks of classical multi‑story buildings lining a river. A multi‑arched bridge crosses the river in the foreground. Dominating the skyline in the left background is a tall, distinctive domed building with a very high spire (the Mole Antonelliana). Printed text at the top right reads the card's series number and the city name with the word 'Panorama.'
